summary: New ERA Energy & Digital, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the prepayment and satisfaction of a $50 million senior secured convertible promissory note initially issued to SharonAI, Inc. in connection with a prior acquisition of Texas Critical Data Centers LLC. The company paid $50 million principal plus accrued interest in cash on April 24, 2026, extinguishing all obligations under the note. This is a routine debt repayment, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No terms were restructured, no new financing was announced, and no strategic change was disclosed. The filing simply confirms the discharge of a pre-existing debt.
